default.heading: Welcome to the NGPF Investing Sim

paragraphs: Welcome to the Investing Sim! This simulation will help you learn about investing by giving you hands-on experience with managing a portfolio.
You'll start with $100,000 in your brokerage account and can invest in various assets including stocks, mutual funds, ETFs, and bonds.
The simulation runs over four quarters, giving you time to make investment decisions and see how your portfolio performs.
Each quarter, you can buy or sell investments based on the current market prices. Track your portfolio's performance and make strategic decisions.
Remember: All trades must be finalized before moving to the next quarter.
Use the tabs at the top to navigate between 'Investing Sim', 'My Bank', and 'My Investing'.
The header shows your current quarter. You can manually select a different quarter from the dropdown, or use the 'Jump to Quarter X' button to advance.
Once you move to a new quarter, you cannot go back - so make sure all your trades are finalized!
Welcome to Quarter 1! You have $100,000 in your brokerage account ready to invest.
This is the perfect time to start building your portfolio. Consider diversifying across different asset types like stocks, index funds, and ETFs.
Take your time to research the available investments and think about your investment strategy.
Make your first investments and begin building your portfolio.
Learn about different asset types: stocks, mutual funds, ETFs, index funds, and bond funds.
Review your portfolio regularly to understand how market movements affect your investments.
Diversification is key - don't put all your money in one asset.
Consider your risk tolerance when choosing investments.
Remember, you can always adjust your strategy in later quarters based on performance.
You've completed Quarter 1! Take a moment to review how your portfolio performed.
Look at which investments gained value and which ones may have declined. Understanding these patterns will help inform your decisions for Quarter 2.
Based on your Quarter 1 results, consider rebalancing your portfolio if needed.
You might want to increase positions in assets that performed well, or adjust your strategy if certain investments didn't meet expectations.
Continue to monitor your portfolio's diversification and risk level.
This quarter, pay attention to how market volatility affects your portfolio.
Consider experimenting with different asset types if you haven't already diversified.
Keep track of your investment goals and adjust accordingly.
You're halfway through the simulation! By now, you should have a good understanding of how your investment choices impact your portfolio.
Review your overall performance and consider what strategies have worked best for you.
This quarter is a great time to optimize your portfolio. Look for opportunities to improve your asset allocation.
Consider whether you need to adjust your risk exposure based on your performance so far.
Think about long-term strategies and how your current investments align with your goals.
If you haven't already, explore bond funds as a way to add stability to your portfolio.
Consider the balance between growth-oriented investments (stocks) and more stable investments (bonds).
Remember that a well-diversified portfolio often performs better over time.
Welcome to Quarter 4, your last opportunity to make changes to your portfolio!
After this quarter, you'll move to the Final Review where you can see your complete performance summary.
Make any final adjustments to your portfolio before the simulation ends.
Consider whether your current allocation meets your investment objectives.
Remember: Once you move to Final Review, you cannot make any more changes.
Take this opportunity to ensure your portfolio is aligned with your investment goals.
Review your overall strategy and see if there are any final optimizations you'd like to make.
After this quarter, you'll be able to see your complete performance report and learn from your investment journey.

2026-01-01.heading: Final Review: Reflecting on Your Journey

paragraphs: You've completed all four quarters of the Investing Sim! Take a moment to reflect on your investment journey.
Review your quarterly statements to see how your portfolio evolved over time.
Check your final portfolio value and compare it to your starting amount of $100,000.
Review each quarter's performance to understand how your investment decisions impacted your returns.
Look at your asset allocation and see how different investments contributed to your overall performance.
Consider what investment strategies worked best for you and why.
Think about the importance of diversification and how it helped (or could have helped) your portfolio.
Reflect on how market movements and timing affected your investments.
Use these insights to inform your understanding of real-world investing!
